title: 会议决策与分歧协调
description: 练习澄清观点、礼貌表达异议、推动决策、确认负责人和落实后续行动。

data.chinese: 我们先明确今天需要做出的决定。
data.english: Let us clarify the decision we need to make today.

data.chinese: 我理解你的观点，但我有一些不同看法。
data.english: I understand your point, but I see it a little differently.

data.chinese: 你能解释一下这个方案背后的假设吗？
data.english: Could you explain the assumptions behind this proposal?

data.chinese: 从客户的角度来看，第二个方案更简单。
data.english: From the customer's perspective, the second option is simpler.

data.chinese: 我们似乎都同意目标，但对方法有分歧。
data.english: We seem to agree on the goal but disagree on the approach.

data.chinese: 有没有一个双方都能接受的折中方案？
data.english: Is there a compromise that both sides can accept?

data.chinese: 我们需要更多数据才能做出明智的决定。
data.english: We need more data to make an informed decision.

data.chinese: 如果没有其他意见，我们就采用这个方案。
data.english: If there are no other objections, we will proceed with this option.

data.chinese: 谁负责跟进这些行动项？
data.english: Who will be responsible for following up on these action items?

data.chinese: 我会在会后发送决定和下一步安排。
data.english: I will send the decision and next steps after the meeting.
